gapPolicy: HTTP 429/403 responses are retained as pending records with null technical values; no value is inferred and a neutral white-stage placeholder is used until the official image is archived.
pdfEvidencePolicy: A record is marked verified only when its exact model appears in the archived JBL 2026 Install catalogue and every card-required field is also supported by that catalogue plus the already archived exact-model JBL product-page snapshot. No values are transferred across generations or variants.
resumeConditions: Resume only after jblpro.com returns HTTP 200 for a single official product-page probe without retries; do not bypass HTTP 403 or 429.
Process one official series per batch with conservative request spacing and stop the batch on the first repeated rate-limit response.
For each pending exact model, archive its official product page, datasheet/manual and manufacturer-original product image before replacing null card fields.
Mark a product verified only when type, network/power mode, way, transducers, maximum SPL, coverage, frequency range, weight and amplification are all supported by exact-model official evidence.
